title: Battles Without a Province
summary: Alfredo approved the standalone court, on-demand help and view-only location navigation. Please review the native implementation of the province-less-battlefield portion of #499.
review_steps: Extract the ZIP, then open Start Review.cmd. The prepared scene has a standalone red brush court, full cards and an Open battlefield caption.
Click either army to inspect its cards. Click the question mark for the no-province explanation; close it with Escape or by clicking outside.
Choose Province and open battlefield or Two open battlefields. Use View battlefield in the sidebar: it should move only the camera; the active battle and where actions belong must remain clear.
Choose Two fronts at one province, then Remove province. Both courts should stay in place, lose their province connection and receive distinct stable Open battlefield labels.
Try Other seat, six extra battlefields, the empty court and crowded/bowed/attached units. Resize the window; check labels stay clear of card faces and every card remains inspectable.
Choose Battle during the Action Phase. The Action phase and Lion turn should remain indicated while Crane has the current opportunity; the sidebar explains why a battle is taking place.

The prepared scenes exercise presentation with effects disabled. Open Full Game.cmd opens the same source build for normal engine-driven gameplay. Report UI/QoL or mechanics-presentation corrections via Send Feedback.url.
known_limitations: This is an unmerged review branch. Alfredo approved the concept direction; Mendon/Nathan mechanics and graphical-playability acceptance remain pending.

Prepared scenarios are isolated public-view presentation fixtures, not live card-effect simulations. A new optional public turn-owner field and retained occupied battlefield associations support correct display; legality, commands and resolution are unchanged.

The concept images show the vertical battle-stage rail from separate open PR #564. This branch is based on main and retains its horizontal stage strip. Reconcile the overlapping UI integration before merge.
Automated Windows checks establish package/runtime and launcher behavior, not native Windows graphical playtesting.

Full local Core, AI, server, transport and tooling checks passed; R1 regressions cover public Action Phase context and resolved occupied extra fronts. Automated checks do not replace expert mechanics acceptance.
